en: A monochrome vintage postcard depicting a steamship moored at a dock. The ship has a tall smokestack, masts with rigging, and several crew or passengers standing along the railings on deck. Calm water surrounds the vessel and the background is mostly sky with light clouds. Printed captions appear along the bottom margin in both Cyrillic and Latin scripts, identifying the location and the name of the ship.
